name: Grilled snakehead
summary: Grilled snakehead, also called cá quả, served at the Liêng Nung spring festival with cơm lam, unseasoned grilled pork, and canh thụt.
origin: The Dak Nong tourism portal’s account of Hội Xuân Liêng Nung, 11 Jan 2023.
where: Hội Xuân Liêng Nung, the spring gathering around Gia Nghia. The same article also writes Liên Nung.
seoTitle: Ca loc nuong — grilled snakehead at Lieng Nung
seoDescription: Snakehead at Hội Xuân Liêng Nung, with cơm lam, unsalted pork, and canh thụt.
